title: pthread Shared<T> + step_clone_thread implementation
summary: Implement Shared<T> infrastructure and step_clone_thread to unblock pthread_create. Two phases: Phase A ships Shared<T> + Frame refactoring (~750 LOC); Phase B ships clone_thread + thread-exit futex protocol (~730 LOC). Total ~1,480 LOC, zero framework changes.

write_sets.notes: Phase A and B are sequential. Phase A must pass check+unit before Phase B starts.

steps.title: A-1: Shared<T> infrastructure
steps.notes: Shared<T> is an Arc<RwLock<T>> wrapper with share()/fork_copy()/get()/get_mut(). COW trigger on get_mut() when inner Arc::strong_count() > 1. fork_copy is semantically share for v1 (COW left to per-subsystem impl).

steps.title: A-2: Frame struct + ProcessPayload field migration
steps.notes: Define Frame with vm/aspace + sig_actions as Shared<T> fields. fds/fd_cloexec stay inline (no FdTable struct yet). cwd/root/umask stay inline. Re-wrap accessors to delegate through frame field.

steps.title: A-3: Adapt fork/clone/exec to Frame
steps.notes: step_fork: when clone_vm, call frame.vm.share() instead of aspace.clone(). sign_process_payload: take Frame instead of individual fields. exec: replace_aspace via frame.vm.get_mut() COW path.

steps.title: A-4: Wire CLONE_FILES / CLONE_SIGHAND / CLONE_FS in clone syscall
steps.notes: Remove EINVAL rejection for CLONE_FILES/CLONE_SIGHAND/CLONE_FS in the fork (non-CLONE_THREAD) path. For non-CLONE_THREAD these flags are semantically fork_copy (the child gets a snapshot). Add CLONE_THREAD to the allowed mask in the clone_thread path.

steps.title: B-5: Implement step_clone_thread
steps.notes: New step: creates ThreadIdentity within existing ProcessIdentity. Shares Frame via Frame::share_all(). Registers new ThreadIdentity in process.threads DLL. Does NOT create a new ProcessIdentity, pid, or pgrp binding. Uses step_engine::sign for ThreadIdentity/ThreadPayload zone allocation.

steps.title: B-6: Wire CLONE_SETTLS / CLONE_PARENT_SETTID / CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID
steps.notes: CLONE_SETTLS: store tls pointer in ThreadPayload (existing tp register field or new slot). CLONE_PARENT_SETTID: write child tid to *ptid user address. CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID: store ctid in ThreadPayload.clear_child_tid slot.

steps.title: B-7: clear_child_tid futex wake on thread exit
steps.notes: In step_thread_exit, after marking thread zombie: if clear_child_tid is Some(addr), atomically write 0 to *addr (via copy_to_user or equivalent), then FUTEX_WAKE on addr with count=1. Must handle the case where the user page is unmapped (best-effort, no panic).

steps.title: B-8: set_robust_list real implementation
steps.notes: Store robust_list_head + len on ThreadPayload. On thread exit, walk the robust list: for each entry, set FUTEX_OWNER_DIED bit + FUTEX_WAKE with count=1. Handle malformed lists gracefully (best-effort, no panic).

verification.notes: Full workspace check after each step
Subsystem unit tests after structural changes
Full workspace unit tests after Phase A and Phase B completion

risks: Frame refactoring touches every ProcessPayload accessor; risk of introducing regressions in fork/clone/exec/exit paths
step_clone_thread shares Frame across threads; risk of deadlock if two threads contend on Frame fields under different lock orders
clear_child_tid + robust list futex operations on userspace addresses require UserAccessIf; may expose gaps in current user-VA handling
Existing fork tests clone ProcessPayload fields individually; Frame migration changes constructor signature — tests need coordinated update
